capsule: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland was created by the Acts of Union 1800, which came into force on 1 January 1801 and merged the Kingdom of Great Britain with the Kingdom of Ireland under a single parliament at Westminster. The UK became the world's pre-eminent industrial and imperial power during the nineteenth century, administering the largest empire in history at its Edwardian apex. The entity dissolved in its original form after the Anglo-Irish Treaty of December 1921, when twenty-six Irish counties seceded to form the Irish Free State on 6 December 1922, and the remainder was reconstituted as the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
